design_choice: emit one artifact per scanned file, including a clean_scan record for every non-collision (569 artifacts: 157+ clean_scans of DR reports alone vs 58 collision_candidates)
boundary_localization: the emission layer, not the detector: the collision detector WORKED (58 candidates; headline registry collisions AA-031/033 trace through its reconciliation) — the design flaw is paying one artifact per 1-bit clean verdict, thesis section 9's volume-over-bits pathology at agent scale
representation_hint: emit only on signal + a single periodic coverage digest (files scanned, clean count); the digest carries the same information as hundreds of clean_scan artifacts
evidence: artifact census by query: {'clean_scan_aporia_docs_deep_research_rep': 157, 'collision_candidate...': 58, ...} — ~73% of artifact mass is 1-bit verdicts

design_choice: harvest papers into a persistent SQLite knowledge graph (163 papers, 93 techniques, 14 motifs) with consumers named as Metis (analyst injection) and Grammata (future UI)
failure_class: CONSUMER-DRIFT (3d named cluster — CONFIRMED, in its strongest form: consumer-never-wired)
boundary_localization: the integration seam, not the harvester: the graph exists and is queryable; grep shows metis_portfolio.py references neither aletheia nor knowledge_graph — the named consumer was never connected, and Grammata was never built. Memory nobody reads is exhaust with a schema
representation_hint: consumer-first wiring: the integration (Metis reading the graph) should have been the FIRST commit, harvesting second — the passive-consumer warning as a build ORDER, not just a review check
evidence: sqlite census this pass: papers 163 / techniques 93 / motifs 14; grep metis_portfolio.py for aletheia|knowledge_graph: zero hits

design_choice: expand per-problem lens catalogs (PROBLEM_LENS_CATALOG@v1) as a rotating daemon on M2
failure_class: PRODUCER-HALT-WITH-LIVE-CONSUMER (NEW class — the inverse of consumer-drift)
boundary_localization: operations/liveness, not design or output: the output PROMOTED (PROBLEM_LENS_CATALOG@v1 and CND_FRAME@v1 are v1-promoted symbols; 13 catalog files exist and are referenced) — the producer died in the July-class collapse and the catalog froze at 13 while its consumers stayed live
representation_hint: a promoted-symbol producer needs a liveness contract visible to its consumers (Alethelia-class staleness surfacing); frozen-at-N is invisible precisely because the existing output keeps working
evidence: 13 catalog .md files (count grew 11->13 then froze); CND_FRAME@v1 promotion references 4 catalog anchors; Argos heartbeat dead since May (P29 staleness sweep)
